cause: Publisher generation_config.json contains Talker options only. The Thinker-only generation call did not explicitly pass the tokenizer end-of-answer token; every free-answer response reached its output cap, often repeating turns or EOS tokens.
fix: Pass tokenizer.eos_token_id and pad_token_id explicitly to Thinker.generate; retain final token ID and configured stop IDs.
choice_note: Replacement-run choice predictions are retained as measured; minor between-run numerical differences are not overwritten.
